description: This file defines an internal class 'ConnectionBuilderDelegates' within the 'Orleans.Configuration' namespace. The class manages a list of delegate actions that configure an 'IConnectionBuilder' object by adding delegates and invoking them on a given builder instance, facilitating configurable connection setup.

classes.name: ConnectionBuilderDelegates
classes.description: A class that manages a list of configuration delegates for IConnectionBuilder instances, allowing addition and invocation of these delegates.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an Action<IConnectionBuilder> delegate to the internal list, throws ArgumentNullException if the delegate is null.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes all stored delegates on the provided IConnectionBuilder instance in sequence.
